info.name: Revochamp Auto-Deployment Backend
info.description: Collection to test the Revochamp auto-deployment system backend endpoints (GitHub connecting, Vercel connecting, project deploying, and status checking).

request.description: Redirects the browser to connect and authorize GitHub OAuth.
Redirects the browser to connect and authorize Vercel OAuth.
Creates a GitHub repository and deploys a single HTML file to Vercel.
Creates a GitHub repository and deploys multiple files as a React project to Vercel.
Fetches the current build/deployment status from Vercel using the deployment ID.
